prompt.sw: Hatua ya kwanza ya kulipa anwani ya Lightning alice@example.com ni ipi?
prompt.en: What is the first step in paying the Lightning Address alice@example.com?

explanation.sw: LUD-16 inageuza anwani kuwa URL ya LNURL-pay iliyo kwenye .well-known.
explanation.en: LUD-16 turns the address into an LNURL-pay URL under .well-known.

prompt.sw: Unataka kulipa sats 100. Utatuma amount gani kwa callback?
prompt.en: You want to pay 100 sats. What amount do you send to the callback?

prompt.sw: Programu ndogo ya Bitsacco inapaswa kushika funguo za watumiaji?
prompt.en: Should a Bitsacco mini-app hold users' keys?

label.sw: Hapana; pochi ya mtumiaji ndiyo inalipa
label.en: No; the user's own wallet pays

label.sw: Ndiyo, ili malipo yawe ya haraka

explanation.sw: Programu inayoonyesha maombi tu haina pesa za kuibiwa.
explanation.en: An app that only shows requests has no funds to be stolen.

prompt.sw: Kwa nini ujaribu dhidi ya seva ya kuiga?
prompt.en: Why test against a mock server?

label.sw: Ili makosa yasigharimu pesa halisi na majaribio yarudiwe
label.en: So mistakes cost no real money and tests are repeatable

label.sw: Kwa sababu Lightning haifanyi kazi kwenye simu
label.en: Because Lightning doesn't work on phones

explanation.sw: Kama regtest, seva ya kuiga hukupa maabara salama.
explanation.en: Like regtest, a mock server gives you a safe lab.
